steps: Boil the potato until just tender, then cool, peel and cut into small cubes.
If the puffed rice has gone soft, toast it in a dry pan for a few minutes and let it cool.
Chop the onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves finely.
Put the puffed rice, potato, onion, tomato and green chilli in a big bowl.
Sprinkle over the chilli powder, chaat masala and a pinch of salt.
Add the chutneys a little at a time, tossing gently so the puffed rice stays crisp.
Squeeze over the lemon, scatter the coriander leaves and sev, and serve right away.
note: Puffed rice goes up from 10 g to 30 g, about two cups, since sev, papdi and peanuts are not in the pack and the puffed rice has to carry the bowl. The 15 g of garlic came from making a whole batch of garlic chutney and is gone; the chutneys are listed as missing instead.
